resources.string: Explore the learner experience with a local sample profile.
This is a sample account. Leave the demo and connect to your server to manage your own account. All demo changes are cleared when you leave.
Two example sessions are included. Finished demo sessions appear here too; open one to review it.
Choose a goal, categories and dates. Completed sessions update the matching daily progress; downloaded practice counts after its sample upload.
A sample session is in progress. Resume it before starting another session or opening a past result. Exam time continues while you browse.
Leave the demo and clear its sample changes? Your account and downloaded study are unaffected.
Case: During a physiology lesson, a learner follows oxygen from the lungs into the blood and around the body. Use this context for the following question.
Choose a mode and question pool, narrow the categories, then select how many questions to practise.
Try connected and offline behavior. This sample server is simulated entirely on this phone.
Sample server offline · Saved content is still available
Finish or discard the current online session before changing the sample connection.
The sample server is offline. Your loaded content, filters and changes are kept. Reconnect and retry.
Reconnect the sample server to start online practice or save changes. Downloaded study remains available offline.
A sample collection is ready. Turn off the sample connection, study offline, then reconnect and upload the completed practice.
Completed on this phone · Upload to the sample server to add it to History, planner progress and analytics.
Added to sample History and progress.
No completed practice is waiting to upload.
Upload the saved completions before starting more downloaded practice.
You can study the saved collection while offline. Upload becomes available after reconnecting.
